result.summary: The image depicts a large, multi-lane intersection with commercial land use and significant asphalt area. While sidewalks and some marked crosswalks are present, the vast crossing distances and lack of pedestrian refuge islands create a high-exposure environment.

hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for a long duration without any mid-point refuge.

hazards.name: Complex Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The multi-leg intersection creates numerous conflict points and unpredictable vehicle turning movements.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at corners to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
